nodes.title: 注意力机制
nodes.summary: 让模型在处理每个词时，动态决定该'看'输入里的哪些其他词、看多重。
nodes.summaryEn: Lets a model decide dynamically which other tokens matter at each position and how much weight to give them.

sources.title: Vaswani et al., Attention Is All You Need
Liu et al., Lost in the Middle

nodes.title: Transformer
nodes.summary: 以注意力机制为核心搭起来的神经网络架构，是当今几乎所有大模型的骨架。
nodes.summaryEn: The attention-centered neural-network architecture that underpins nearly every modern large language model.

sources.title: Vaswani et al., Attention Is All You Need
Xiong et al., On Layer Normalization in the Transformer Architecture
Meng et al. — Locating and Editing Factual Associations in GPT (NeurIPS 2022)
Raffel et al. — Exploring the Limits of Transfer Learning with a Unified Text-to-Text Transformer (JMLR 2020)

nodes.title: 残差连接
nodes.summary: 让输入直接绕过一层与输出相加，是深层网络能训起来的结构性前提。
nodes.summaryEn: Adds a layer's input directly to its output, providing a structural path that makes very deep networks trainable.

sources.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
Identity Mappings in Deep Residual Networks
On Layer Normalization in the Transformer Architecture

nodes.title: 梯度消失
nodes.summary: 梯度在层层回传中不断相乘，指数级衰减到接近零，导致浅层学不动。
nodes.summaryEn: Gradients can shrink exponentially toward zero as they propagate backward through many layers, preventing early layers from learning.

sources.title: Understanding the difficulty of training deep feedforward neural networks
Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition

nodes.title: 缩放定律
nodes.summary: 模型规模、数据量、算力同步放大时，损失会以可预测的幂律下降。
nodes.summaryEn: Describes predictable power-law reductions in loss when model size, data, and compute are increased in suitable proportions.

sources.title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
Emergent Abilities of Large Language Models
Are Emergent Abilities of Large Language Models a Mirage?

nodes.title: 大语言模型 LLM
nodes.summary: 在海量文本上训练出的超大 Transformer，本质是在预测下一个 token。
nodes.summaryEn: A very large Transformer trained on massive text corpora, fundamentally by predicting the next token.

sources.title: Brown et al., Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
Kaplan et al., Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
Ouyang et al., Training language models to follow instructions

nodes.title: Token 与分词
nodes.summary: 模型看不见字符，只看见 token —— 文本被切成的一个个小片段。
nodes.summaryEn: Converts text into tokens—the discrete pieces a model processes instead of directly seeing characters or words.

sources.title: Neural Machine Translation of Rare Words with Subword Units
SentencePiece: A simple and language independent subword tokenizer and detokenizer
Neural Machine Translation with Byte-Level Subwords
Unicode Standard Annex #15: Unicode Normalization Forms

nodes.title: 嵌入 Embedding
nodes.summary: 把文本变成一串数字（向量），让语义相近的内容在向量空间里也靠得近。
nodes.summaryEn: Turns text into a vector so that semantically similar content is also nearby in vector space.

sources.title: Mikolov et al., Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space
Radford et al., Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision

nodes.title: 上下文窗口
nodes.summary: 模型单次能「看见」的 token 总量上限——它的工作台有多大。
nodes.summaryEn: The maximum number of tokens a model can see in one request—the size of its working surface.

sources.title: Vaswani et al., Attention Is All You Need
Liu et al., Lost in the Middle

nodes.title: 中间迷失
nodes.summary: 放在上下文中段的信息，模型的利用率明显低于放在开头和结尾。
nodes.summaryEn: Information placed in the middle of a long context is often used less reliably than the same information placed near the beginning or end.

sources.title: Liu et al., Lost in the Middle
Hsieh et al., RULER: What's the Real Context Size of Your Long-Context Language Models?
TACL publication: Lost in the Middle

nodes.title: 采样与解码参数
nodes.summary: 控制模型从「下一个词的概率分布」里怎么挑的一组旋钮。
nodes.summaryEn: Controls how a generation system selects the next token from the model's probability distribution.

sources.title: The Curious Case of Neural Text Degeneration
Truncation Sampling as Language Model Desmoothing

nodes.title: 微调 Fine-tuning
nodes.summary: 在预训练模型的基础上，用特定数据继续训练，改变模型的权重。
nodes.summaryEn: Continues training a pretrained model on targeted data so that its weights and behavioral tendencies change.

nodes.title: 神经网络
nodes.summary: 由多层可调参数的简单单元堆叠而成、通过数据自动学习映射关系的模型。
nodes.summaryEn: A model built from layers of simple units with adjustable parameters that learns mappings from data.

sources.title: Google ML Crash Course: Neural networks ↗

nodes.title: 梯度下降
nodes.summary: 沿着「误差下降最快的方向」一小步一小步调整参数，是模型训练的基本方法。
nodes.summaryEn: Adjusts parameters a small step at a time in the direction that reduces error fastest, forming the basic method for training models.

sources.title: Deep Learning — Optimization for Training Deep Models
Practical Recommendations for Gradient-Based Training of Deep Architectures
Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization

nodes.title: 反向传播
nodes.summary: 高效计算「每个参数该往哪调」的算法，让深层网络的训练成为可能。
nodes.summaryEn: Efficiently calculates how every parameter should change, making deep neural network training computationally feasible.

sources.title: Automatic Differentiation in Machine Learning: a Survey
Training Deep Nets with Sublinear Memory Cost

nodes.title: 过拟合
nodes.summary: 模型把训练数据背下来了，包括其中的噪声，导致遇到新数据就失灵。
nodes.summaryEn: The model memorizes the training data, including its noise, and then fails on new data.

sources.title: Deep Learning — Regularization for Deep Learning
Reconciling modern machine-learning practice and the classical bias–variance trade-off
Deduplicating Training Data Makes Language Models Better
scikit-learn — Common pitfalls and recommended practices

nodes.title: 卷积神经网络 CNN
nodes.summary: 用滑动的小窗口在图像上提取局部特征的网络，长期是计算机视觉的主力。
nodes.summaryEn: Uses small sliding filters to extract local features from images and was the dominant computer-vision architecture for many years.

sources.title: A Guide to Convolution Arithmetic for Deep Learning
ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition

nodes.title: 循环神经网络 RNN
nodes.summary: 按顺序逐个处理序列、并把「记忆」传给下一步的网络，Transformer 之前的序列主力。
nodes.summaryEn: Processes a sequence one step at a time while passing a hidden state forward; it was the main sequence architecture before Transformers.

sources.title: Learning Long-Term Dependencies with Gradient Descent is Difficult
Learning Phrase Representations using RNN Encoder–Decoder
Scheduled Sampling for Sequence Prediction with Recurrent Neural Networks

nodes.title: 监督学习
nodes.summary: 用带标准答案的数据训练模型，让它学会从输入预测输出。
nodes.summaryEn: Trains a model on data paired with correct answers so that it learns to predict outputs from inputs.

sources.title: Deep Learning, Chapter 5: Machine Learning Basics
Learning from Noisy Labels with Deep Neural Networks: A Survey
Training Language Models to Follow Instructions with Human Feedback

nodes.title: 无监督学习
nodes.summary: 从没有标注的数据中自己找出结构与规律。
nodes.summaryEn: Finds structure and patterns in unlabeled data without being given correct answers.

nodes.title: 强化学习
nodes.summary: 让智能体在环境中试错，用奖励信号学出一套行为策略。
nodes.summaryEn: Lets an agent learn a behavior policy through trial and error in an environment, guided by reward signals.

sources.title: Playing Atari with Deep Reinforcement Learning
Conservative Q-Learning for Offline Reinforcement Learning

nodes.title: 自监督学习
nodes.summary: 从数据本身构造训练目标，不需要人工标注——大模型时代的直接前提。
nodes.summaryEn: Constructs training targets from the data itself, avoiding manual labels and directly enabling training at foundation-model scale.

sources.title: A Simple Framework for Contrastive Learning of Visual Representations
Emerging Properties in Self-Supervised Vision Transformers
Masked Autoencoders Are Scalable Vision Learners

nodes.title: 正则化
nodes.summary: 一整套限制模型「死记硬背」能力的手段，用来对付过拟合。
nodes.summaryEn: A family of techniques that restrict a model's ability to memorize and thereby combat overfitting.

sources.title: Deep Learning — Regularization for Deep Learning
Dropout: A Simple Way to Prevent Neural Networks from Overfitting

nodes.title: 决策树与集成方法
nodes.summary: 用一连串「是/否」判断做预测的模型，以及把多棵树组合起来的增强方法。
nodes.summaryEn: Uses a sequence of yes-or-no decisions to predict an outcome, with ensemble methods combining many trees for stronger performance.

sources.title: Greedy Function Approximation: A Gradient Boosting Machine

nodes.title: 聚类
nodes.summary: 在没有标签的情况下，把相似的样本自动分成若干组。
nodes.summaryEn: Automatically divides similar examples into groups when no labels are available.

sources.title: k-means++: The Advantages of Careful Seeding

nodes.title: 降维
nodes.summary: 把高维数据压缩到低维，同时尽量保留原有的结构信息。
nodes.summaryEn: Compresses high-dimensional data into fewer dimensions while preserving as much of its original structure as possible.

sources.title: An elementary proof of a theorem of Johnson and Lindenstrauss
Reducing the Dimensionality of Data with Neural Networks
Challenging Common Assumptions in the Unsupervised Learning of Disentangled Representations

nodes.title: 维度灾难
nodes.summary: 维度越高，空间越空旷，「距离」越失去区分度——高维空间不符合直觉。
nodes.summaryEn: As dimensionality increases, space becomes sparse and distance loses its discriminating power; high-dimensional geometry defies intuition.

nodes.title: 预训练
nodes.summary: 在海量无标注文本上做自监督训练，是大模型能力的主要来源。
nodes.summaryEn: Large-scale self-supervised training on unlabeled text, where most of a language model's general capabilities are acquired.

sources.title: Brown et al., Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
Hoffmann et al., Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models

nodes.title: RAG 检索增强生成
nodes.summary: 回答前先去知识库检索相关资料，连同问题一起交给模型，让它基于材料作答。
nodes.summaryEn: Retrieves relevant knowledge before answering and gives it to the model with the question so the response can be grounded in evidence.

sources.title: Karpukhin et al., Dense Passage Retrieval
Liu et al., Lost in the Middle

nodes.title: 向量数据库
nodes.summary: 专门存储向量并支持「找出最相似的 K 个」这种查询的数据库。
nodes.summaryEn: Stores vectors and supports queries that return the K most similar items rather than exact matches alone.

sources.title: Efficient and robust approximate nearest neighbor search using HNSW

nodes.title: 提示工程
nodes.summary: 通过设计输入的措辞与结构，让模型稳定产出你想要的结果。
nodes.summaryEn: Designs the wording and structure of an input so a model produces the intended result consistently.

sources.title: A practical guide to building agents (OpenAI)

nodes.title: 文档切分 Chunking
nodes.summary: 把长文档切成小块，让检索能定位到片段而不是整本书。
nodes.summaryEn: Divides long documents into smaller units so retrieval can locate a relevant passage instead of returning an entire book.

nodes.title: 检索与语义搜索
nodes.summary: 根据问题从知识库里找出最相关的内容——RAG 效果的真正瓶颈。
nodes.summaryEn: Finds the most relevant material in a knowledge base for a question—the real performance bottleneck in RAG.

sources.title: Karpukhin et al., Dense Passage Retrieval

nodes.title: 重排 Reranking
nodes.summary: 对召回的候选逐条精算相关性并重新排序，是「先粗筛后精排」的第二步。
nodes.summaryEn: Scores retrieved candidates more precisely and reorders them as the accurate second stage of a fast-then-precise retrieval pipeline.

sources.title: Is ChatGPT Good at Search? RankGPT

nodes.title: 约束解码
nodes.summary: 在生成的每一步屏蔽掉会破坏格式的 token，从机制上保证输出合法。
nodes.summaryEn: Masks tokens that would violate a target format at every generation step, making syntactically invalid output impossible.

nodes.title: 提示缓存
nodes.summary: 把重复出现的提示前缀的中间计算结果缓存下来，省掉重复计算。
nodes.summaryEn: Caches intermediate computation for an unchanged prompt prefix so later requests do not have to recompute it.

sources.title: vLLM: Easy, Fast, and Cheap LLM Serving with PagedAttention

nodes.title: 结构化输出
nodes.summary: 让模型稳定吐出程序能直接解析的格式，而不是一段自然语言。
nodes.summaryEn: Makes model output reliably parseable by software, usually by requiring it to conform to a declared schema.

nodes.title: 思维链 CoT
nodes.summary: 让模型把推理过程写出来再给答案，复杂任务上准确率明显提升。
nodes.summaryEn: Lets a model produce intermediate reasoning before its answer, often improving accuracy on complex tasks.

nodes.title: AI Agent
nodes.summary: 能自主循环「思考→调用工具→看结果→再思考」直到完成任务的 LLM 系统。
nodes.summaryEn: An LLM system that can repeatedly reason, call tools, inspect results, and adapt until it completes a task.

sources.title: A practical guide to building agents (OpenAI)
Wang et al., A Survey on Large Language Model based Autonomous Agents

nodes.title: 工具调用 / 函数调用
nodes.summary: 让模型输出结构化的「调用意图」，由外部程序实际执行并把结果回传。
nodes.summaryEn: Lets a model produce a structured request for an external program to execute and return the result.

sources.title: A practical guide to building agents (OpenAI)

nodes.title: MCP 模型上下文协议
nodes.summary: 把「模型如何连接外部工具与数据」标准化的开放协议。
nodes.summaryEn: An open protocol that standardizes how models connect to external tools and data.

nodes.title: MCP 架构
nodes.summary: MCP 的三个角色（Host / Client / Server）与两种传输方式。
nodes.summaryEn: Explains the three MCP participants—host, client, and server—and the local and remote transports that connect them.

nodes.title: Agent 循环
nodes.summary: Agent 反复执行的四步：接收输入 → 推理规划 → 调用工具 → 观察结果。
nodes.summaryEn: Repeats four steps—receive input, reason and plan, invoke a tool, then observe the result—until an explicit exit condition is met.

sources.title: Wang et al., LLM-based Autonomous Agents Survey

nodes.title: Agent 记忆
nodes.summary: 让 Agent 跨轮次、跨会话保留信息的机制——上下文窗口装不下的部分。
nodes.summaryEn: Mechanisms that let an agent retain useful information across turns and sessions when everything cannot remain in the context window.

nodes.title: 扩散模型
nodes.summary: 通过学习「从噪声一步步去噪」来生成内容的模型，当今图像生成的主流。
nodes.summaryEn: Generative models that learn to remove noise step by step and now power much of modern image generation.

sources.title: Ho et al., Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
Rombach et al., High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models

nodes.title: 图像生成
nodes.summary: 根据文本描述生成图像，当前主要由扩散模型驱动。
nodes.summaryEn: Generates images from text descriptions, currently driven mainly by diffusion models.

sources.title: Rombach et al., Latent Diffusion Models
Ramesh et al., Hierarchical Text-Conditional Image Generation with CLIP Latents

nodes.title: 多模态
nodes.summary: 让一个模型同时处理文本、图像、音频等不同形式的信息。
nodes.summaryEn: Lets one model process and relate several forms of information, including text, images, audio, and video.

nodes.title: 生成对抗网络 GAN
nodes.summary: 让生成器和判别器对抗训练来生成内容，扩散模型之前的图像生成主力。
nodes.summaryEn: Trains a generator and discriminator in opposition to produce samples, the dominant image-generation approach before diffusion models.

nodes.title: 语音识别与合成
nodes.summary: 语音转文字（识别）与文字转语音（合成），两个反向的任务。
nodes.summaryEn: Covers the two inverse tasks of converting speech to text and text to speech.

nodes.title: 视频生成
nodes.summary: 根据文本或图像生成连续视频，难点在于时间一致性。
nodes.summaryEn: Generates a sequence of video frames from text or images, with temporal consistency as the defining challenge.

nodes.title: 可控生成
nodes.summary: 在纯文本提示之外，用额外条件精确控制生成结果。
nodes.summaryEn: Uses conditions beyond a text prompt to control composition, pose, identity, or selected regions of generated images.

sources.title: Adding Conditional Control to Text-to-Image Diffusion Models

nodes.title: LLM 应用评测
nodes.summary: 系统地衡量一个 LLM 应用好不好——没有它，一切优化都是盲调。
nodes.summaryEn: Uses repeatable tests and comparable scores to determine whether a change improves or degrades an LLM application.

nodes.title: 高级 RAG
nodes.summary: 在基础 RAG 之上加一层处理，解决「检索不到」和「检索不够」的问题。
nodes.summaryEn: Adds processing around a basic RAG pipeline to repair queries, combine distributed evidence, or perform retrieval iteratively.

sources.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Large Language Models: A Survey
Precise Zero-Shot Dense Retrieval without Relevance Labels (HyDE)
Reciprocal Rank Fusion outperforms Condorcet and individual Rank Learning Methods

nodes.title: 推理优化
nodes.summary: 让模型跑得更快更省的一组技术，大多围绕 KV 缓存和注意力。
nodes.summaryEn: Collects engineering techniques that make model inference faster, cheaper, and more memory-efficient.

sources.title: Fast Inference from Transformers via Speculative Decoding

nodes.title: 量化 Quantization
nodes.summary: 用更低精度存储模型权重，大幅减小体积和显存，换取轻微的质量损失。
nodes.summaryEn: Stores model weights at lower numerical precision, sharply reducing size and memory use in exchange for some loss of quality.

nodes.title: 部署形态
nodes.summary: 把模型跑起来对外服务的几种方式，各有隐私、成本、可控性的取舍。
nodes.summaryEn: Compares the main ways to serve a trained model, each with different privacy, cost, control, and capability trade-offs.

sources.title: Hidden Technical Debt in Machine Learning Systems

nodes.title: RLHF 与偏好对齐
nodes.summary: 用人类偏好训练模型倾向于「人更想要的」回答——把基座模型调教成助手的关键一步。
nodes.summaryEn: Uses comparisons between model responses to train behavior toward human preferences, through RLHF or related direct methods.

sources.title: Ouyang et al., Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
Christiano et al., Deep Reinforcement Learning from Human Preferences
Rafailov et al., Direct Preference Optimization

nodes.title: 红队测试
nodes.summary: 主动扮演攻击者去攻破自己的模型，在上线前找出漏洞。
nodes.summaryEn: Actively attacks an AI system before release to discover safety and security failures.

sources.title: Red Teaming Language Models with Language Models

nodes.title: 可解释性
nodes.summary: 试图搞清楚模型内部到底在做什么——目前仍是开放的研究前沿。
nodes.summaryEn: Investigates why models produce particular outputs and remains an active, unresolved research frontier.

sources.title: A Mathematical Framework for Transformer Circuits

nodes.title: 混合专家 MoE
nodes.summary: 把大模型拆成很多「专家」，每个 token 只激活一小部分，参数量大但计算省。
nodes.summaryEn: Splits a large model into many expert subnetworks and activates only a few for each token, increasing parameter capacity without proportional computation.

nodes.title: 模型蒸馏
nodes.summary: 用大模型当老师训练小模型，让小模型学到接近大模型的能力。
nodes.summaryEn: Uses a larger teacher model to train a smaller student so the student can approach the teacher's behavior at lower inference cost.

sources.title: Distilling the Knowledge in a Neural Network

nodes.title: 合成数据
nodes.summary: 用模型生成训练数据，应对真实高质量数据见底的问题。
nodes.summaryEn: Uses model-generated training data to address shortages of high-quality real-world data.

nodes.title: 主流模型家族
nodes.summary: 当前主要的大模型家族及其定位——这是变化最快的一层。
nodes.summaryEn: Maps the major large-model families by durable decision criteria rather than short-lived rankings, versions, or prices.

sources.title: Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners
Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision

nodes.title: 幻觉 Hallucination
nodes.summary: 模型生成了流畅、自信，但事实上错误或纯属虚构的内容。
nodes.summaryEn: Fluent and confident model output that is factually wrong or entirely fabricated.

sources.title: Kalai & Vempala, Calibrated Language Models Must Hallucinate

nodes.title: 提示注入
nodes.summary: 把恶意指令藏在模型会读到的内容里，劫持它的行为。
nodes.summaryEn: Hides malicious instructions in content a model will read in order to redirect its behavior.

sources.title: Yi et al., Benchmarking and Defending Against Indirect Prompt Injection Attacks (BIPIA)

nodes.title: 越狱 Jailbreak
nodes.summary: 用特定措辞诱导模型绕过自身的安全限制，说出本不该说的内容。
nodes.summaryEn: Uses crafted language to induce a model to bypass its own safety restrictions.

sources.title: Universal and Transferable Adversarial Attacks on Aligned Language Models

nodes.title: 奖励黑客
nodes.summary: 系统找到了让奖励变高、却违背设计者本意的捷径——它没做错，是目标没写对。
nodes.summaryEn: Occurs when a system maximizes a measurable reward through a shortcut that violates the designer's actual intent.

sources.title: Amodei et al., Concrete Problems in AI Safety
DeepMind, Specification gaming: the flip side of AI ingenuity
DeepMind, Maximizing Overall Agent Reward and Avoiding Reward Tampering

nodes.title: 对齐 Alignment
nodes.summary: 让模型的行为符合人类意图与价值观的一整套技术与目标。
nodes.summaryEn: The collection of goals and techniques intended to make model behavior follow human intentions and values.

sources.title: Rafailov et al., Direct Preference Optimization

nodes.title: 推理模型
nodes.summary: 在回答前先生成一段长思考过程的模型，用推理时的算力换准确率。
nodes.summaryEn: Models that perform an extended reasoning process before answering, trading inference-time compute for accuracy.

sources.title: OpenAI：Learning to reason with LLMs（训练时与测试时计算）↗
OpenAI：Evaluating chain-of-thought monitorability（隐藏推理与可监控性）↗
Wang et al.：Self-Consistency Improves Chain of Thought Reasoning ↗
Snell et al.：Scaling LLM Test-Time Compute Optimally（按难度分配预算）↗
Lightman et al.：Let's Verify Step by Step（过程监督与验证器）↗

nodes.title: Agent 框架
nodes.summary: 帮你搭 Agent 循环、状态管理和多 Agent 编排的工具库。
nodes.summaryEn: Libraries and SDKs that provide agent loops, state management, and multi-agent orchestration.

sources.title: A practical guide to building agents (OpenAI)

nodes.title: 多 Agent 编排
nodes.summary: 把工作拆给多个 Agent 协作完成，两种主流模式：中心调度与对等交接。
nodes.summaryEn: Coordinates specialized agents through two common patterns: a central manager or transfer of control through handoffs.

sources.title: A practical guide to building agents (OpenAI)

nodes.title: 护栏 Guardrails
nodes.summary: 在模型前后加多道独立检查，用分层防御把风险挡在外面。
nodes.summaryEn: Places multiple independent checks around model input, output, and tool use so risk is addressed through layered defense.

sources.title: A practical guide to building agents (OpenAI)

nodes.title: 模型选型与成本
nodes.summary: 不是所有任务都需要最强的模型——先用最强的建立基线，再往下换。
nodes.summaryEn: Not every task needs the strongest model: establish a quality baseline first, then move each step to the least expensive model that still passes it.

sources.title: A practical guide to building agents (OpenAI)

nodes.title: 上下文学习
nodes.summary: 模型只靠提示里的几个例子就学会新任务，不改一个权重。
nodes.summaryEn: Allows a model to infer a new task from examples in the prompt without updating any model weights.

sources.title: An Explanation of In-context Learning as Implicit Bayesian Inference

nodes.title: 上下文工程
nodes.summary: 决定每次调用时上下文窗口里到底放什么——比雕琢单条提示更上层的问题。
nodes.summaryEn: Decides what should occupy a limited context window, how much to include, and where to place it.

sources.title: Liu et al., Lost in the Middle

nodes.title: ReAct 推理+行动
nodes.summary: 让模型交替进行「推理」和「调用工具」，是 Agent 循环的经典范式。
nodes.summaryEn: Interleaves reasoning with tool use so observations from real actions can update the next reasoning step.

nodes.title: 数据投毒
nodes.summary: 在训练数据里掺入恶意样本，让模型学到攻击者想要的行为。
nodes.summaryEn: Plants malicious examples in training data so a model learns behavior chosen by an attacker.

sources.title: Targeted Backdoor Attacks on Deep Learning Systems
Poisoning Web-Scale Training Datasets is Practical

nodes.title: 对抗样本与鲁棒性
nodes.summary: 对输入做人眼难察的微小扰动，就能让模型给出完全错误的结果。
nodes.summaryEn: Studies small, deliberately constructed input changes that cause model failure and the defenses against them.

sources.title: Towards Deep Learning Models Resistant to Adversarial Attacks
Obfuscated Gradients Give a False Sense of Security
On Adaptive Attacks to Adversarial Example Defenses

nodes.title: 偏见与公平性
nodes.summary: 模型会继承并放大训练数据里的社会偏见，在关键决策场景造成不公。
nodes.summaryEn: Examines how models inherit or amplify social bias and can create systematic unfairness in consequential decisions.

sources.title: Equality of Opportunity in Supervised Learning
Inherent Trade-Offs in the Fair Determination of Risk Scores

nodes.title: 隐私与数据合规
nodes.summary: 模型可能记住并泄露训练数据，加上数据出境等合规约束，是落地的硬门槛。
nodes.summaryEn: Covers personal-data leakage, data movement, and compliance constraints that can determine whether an AI system may be deployed at all.

sources.title: The Algorithmic Foundations of Differential Privacy
Extracting Training Data from Large Language Models

nodes.title: AI 治理与法规
nodes.summary: 管理 AI 风险的制度、标准与法律——技术之外，决定 AI 怎么被允许使用。
nodes.summaryEn: Covers laws, standards, accountability, and organizational processes for managing AI risk beyond technical controls.

nodes.title: 流式输出
nodes.summary: 模型一边生成一边把 token 逐个吐出来，而不是等全部生成完再返回。
nodes.summaryEn: Sends generated tokens to the client as they become available instead of waiting for the complete response.

nodes.title: Logprobs 与置信度
nodes.summary: 模型每步输出的 token 概率，可用来估计它对自己回答有多确定。
nodes.summaryEn: Exposes the model's probability for each generated token as a signal of how strongly it favored that choice.

sources.title: On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks
Selective Classification for Deep Neural Networks

nodes.title: 系统提示与角色提示
nodes.summary: 在对话最前面设定模型的身份、规则和边界，贯穿整场对话。
nodes.summaryEn: Sets the model's role, rules, and boundaries at the start of a conversation so they can shape every turn.

nodes.title: 自洽性
nodes.summary: 同一问题让模型独立解多次，取多数答案，比单次思维链更可靠。
nodes.summaryEn: Samples several independent reasoning paths for the same problem and selects the most consistent final answer.

sources.title: Self-Consistency Improves Chain of Thought Reasoning
Training Verifiers to Solve Math Word Problems

nodes.title: 思维树 ToT
nodes.summary: 让模型像搜索一样展开多条推理分支、评估、回溯，而不是一条道走到黑。
nodes.summaryEn: Expands, evaluates, and backtracks across multiple reasoning branches instead of committing to one linear chain.

nodes.title: 可观测性与追踪
nodes.summary: 记录 LLM 应用每次调用的全过程，让你能看清、能调试、能算账。
nodes.summaryEn: Records each LLM application call and its surrounding steps so teams can inspect behavior, debug failures, and account for cost.

sources.title: Hidden Technical Debt in Machine Learning Systems
Google SRE Workbook: Alerting on SLOs

nodes.title: 代码执行与沙箱
nodes.summary: 让模型写代码并真正跑起来，用执行结果解决它自己算不准的问题。
nodes.summaryEn: Lets a model write and run code inside an isolated environment, using objective execution results to solve tasks it cannot compute reliably in language alone.

nodes.title: 计算机操作
nodes.summary: 让 Agent 像人一样看屏幕、点鼠标、敲键盘，操作没有 API 的软件。
nodes.summaryEn: Lets an agent perceive a screen and operate mouse and keyboard controls when software has no suitable API.

nodes.title: 自我反思
nodes.summary: 让模型检查并批判自己的输出，再据此改进——用一轮自我审视换质量。
nodes.summaryEn: Has a model inspect and criticize its own output, then revise it using one additional round of computation.

sources.title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
CRITIC: Large Language Models Can Self-Correct with Tool-Interactive Critiquing
Large Language Models Cannot Self-Correct Reasoning Yet

nodes.title: 知识图谱与 GraphRAG
nodes.summary: 把知识组织成实体和关系的网络，让检索能沿关系走、能做全局归纳。
nodes.summaryEn: Organizes knowledge as a network of entities and relations so retrieval can traverse connections and summarize global structure.

nodes.title: CLIP 图文对比学习
nodes.summary: 用海量图文配对训练，让图片和描述它的文字在向量空间里对齐。
nodes.summaryEn: Trains on large collections of image–text pairs so images and their natural-language descriptions align in one vector space.

sources.title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
Scaling Up Visual and Vision-Language Representation Learning With Noisy Text Supervision
Sigmoid Loss for Language Image Pre-Training

nodes.title: 变分自编码器 VAE
nodes.summary: 把数据压进一个连续的潜在空间再重建，生成模型三巨头之一。
nodes.summaryEn: Encodes data into a continuous latent distribution and reconstructs it, providing a stable generative model and a key component of latent diffusion.

sources.title: Auto-Encoding Variational Bayes, ICLR Test of Time

nodes.title: 音频与音乐生成
nodes.summary: 生成音乐、音效、环境声——和语音合成是不同的任务。
nodes.summaryEn: Generates music, sound effects, and ambient audio, a different task from speech synthesis.

nodes.title: 图像编辑
nodes.summary: 在已有图片上按指令修改，而不是从零生成——实用场景的主力。
nodes.summaryEn: Modifies an existing image through masks or instructions, preserving most of the source instead of generating from scratch.

nodes.title: 超分辨率与修复
nodes.summary: 把低清图放大、把破损图修好——用生成能力补出缺失的细节。
nodes.summaryEn: Upscales low-resolution images or repairs degraded ones by predicting plausible detail that the input does not contain.

sources.title: Photo-Realistic Single Image Super-Resolution Using a GAN

nodes.title: 世界模型与 3D 生成
nodes.summary: 生成的不只是一张图或一段视频，而是可交互、有物理规律的三维世界。
nodes.summaryEn: Moves beyond fixed images or clips toward interactive three-dimensional environments that respond to actions.

sources.title: Dream to Control: Learning Behaviors by Latent Imagination
Mastering Diverse Domains through World Models
PETS: Deep Reinforcement Learning in a Handful of Trials using Probabilistic Dynamics Models

nodes.title: AIGC 检测与水印
nodes.summary: 判断一张图/一段文/一段音是不是 AI 生成的——生成能力越强，越难也越必要。
nodes.summaryEn: Examines post-hoc detection, embedded watermarks, and provenance for distinguishing generated media from authentic content.

sources.title: A Watermark for Large Language Models
Can AI-Generated Text be Reliably Detected?

nodes.title: 代码生成 / AI 编程
nodes.summary: 让模型写代码——从补全一行到实现整个功能，AI 最成功的应用之一。
nodes.summaryEn: Uses models to write software, from completing one line to implementing a feature—one of AI's most successful applications.

sources.title: Chen et al., Evaluating Large Language Models Trained on Code

nodes.title: 规划与任务分解
nodes.summary: 把一个大目标拆成可执行的小步骤——Agent 能不能办成复杂任务的关键。
nodes.summaryEn: Breaks a complex goal into ordered, executable steps before or during action—the blueprint for an agent's work.

nodes.title: 人在回路
nodes.summary: 在关键或不可逆的步骤上让人介入确认，是 Agent 安全落地的现实底线。
nodes.summaryEn: Places human judgment at consequential or irreversible steps—the practical safety boundary for deployed agents.

nodes.title: AI 编程工具
nodes.summary: 把代码生成、执行、仓库理解整合进开发流程的工具，这一层变化极快。
nodes.summaryEn: Integrates code generation, execution, and repository understanding into development workflows, from completion to coding agents.

nodes.title: 工作流编排
nodes.summary: 用预先定义好的固定流程串起多次 LLM 调用，和自主 Agent 是两条路。
nodes.summaryEn: Connects multiple LLM calls through a predefined process, providing a more deterministic alternative to an autonomous agent.

nodes.title: 宪法 AI
nodes.summary: 让模型对照一套写下来的原则自我批判、自我修正，用 AI 反馈替代大量人工标注。
nodes.summaryEn: Uses an explicit set of principles to guide self-critique, revision, and AI-generated preference feedback for alignment.

sources.title: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
Training a Helpful and Harmless Assistant with Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback

nodes.title: 响应预填充
nodes.summary: 把助手回复的开头先替它写好，强力约束输出的格式和走向。
nodes.summaryEn: Supplies the beginning of an assistant response so that the model continues along a strongly constrained format or direction.

sources.title: Anchoring Effects in Large Language Models

nodes.title: 引用与溯源
nodes.summary: 让模型的回答带出处、可核实——把「信不信它」变成「查一查」。
nodes.summaryEn: Attaches verifiable source locations to model claims, turning trust in the model into inspection of the evidence.

nodes.title: 上下文压缩
nodes.summary: 长任务里自动把旧上下文摘要、裁剪，腾出窗口又不丢关键信息。
nodes.summaryEn: Summarizes or removes older context during a long task so work can continue without losing all important state.

nodes.title: 智能体技能
nodes.summary: 把一套指令、工具、知识打包成可复用、可按需加载的「技能」，供 Agent 调用。
nodes.summaryEn: Packages instructions, tools, and reference knowledge into reusable capabilities that an agent can load when needed.

nodes.title: 批归一化 Batch Norm
nodes.summary: 训练时按小批量的统计量把每层输入归一化到稳定分布，让深层网络训得更快、更稳。
nodes.summaryEn: Normalizes layer inputs using mini-batch statistics so deep networks train faster and more stably.

sources.title: Batch Normalization: Accelerating Deep Network Training by Reducing Internal Covariate Shift
How Does Batch Normalization Help Optimization?
MegDet: A Large Mini-Batch Object Detector

nodes.title: 损失函数
nodes.summary: 把「预测离目标有多远」压成一个数，训练就是不断调参数把这个数变小。
nodes.summaryEn: Compresses the distance between a prediction and its target into one number; training repeatedly adjusts parameters to make that number smaller.

sources.title: Deep Learning — Optimization for Training Deep Models
Robust Estimation of a Location Parameter
Focal Loss for Dense Object Detection

nodes.title: 信息论与熵
nodes.summary: 用「熵」量化不确定性与信息量，交叉熵、KL 散度是训练与评估语言模型的基本度量。
nodes.summaryEn: Uses entropy to quantify uncertainty and information; cross-entropy and KL divergence are fundamental measures for training and evaluating language models.

sources.title: Shannon, A Mathematical Theory of Communication
Deep Learning — Probability and Information Theory
Stanford STATS 311: Information Theory and Statistics

nodes.title: 核方法与 SVM
nodes.summary: 用「核技巧」在高维空间找最大间隔的分界面，深度学习兴起前最强的分类器之一。
nodes.summaryEn: Uses the kernel trick to find a maximum-margin boundary in a high-dimensional space; it was one of the strongest classifiers before deep learning.

sources.title: A Tutorial on Support Vector Machines
Random Features for Large-Scale Kernel Machines

nodes.title: 后训练 Post-training
nodes.summary: 在预训练之后，用指令、偏好与可验证反馈把基座模型塑造成可用助手。
nodes.summaryEn: Uses instructions, preferences, and verifiable feedback after pre-training to turn a base model into a useful assistant.

nodes.title: 位置编码与 RoPE
nodes.summary: 把顺序和相对距离注入注意力，否则 Transformer 无法区分 token 的先后。
nodes.summaryEn: Injects order and relative distance into attention; without it, a Transformer cannot distinguish the order of tokens.

sources.title: RoFormer: Enhanced Transformer with Rotary Position Embedding
Train Short, Test Long: Attention with Linear Biases
Extending Context Window of Large Language Models via Positional Interpolation

nodes.title: 层归一化与 RMSNorm
nodes.summary: 按单个样本的特征维稳定激活尺度，是深层 Transformer 能稳定训练的关键组件。
nodes.summaryEn: Stabilizes activation scales across the features of each example and is a key component in training deep Transformers reliably.

sources.title: On Layer Normalization in the Transformer Architecture

nodes.title: 优化器与学习率调度
nodes.summary: 决定拿到梯度后怎样更新参数、每一步走多远，直接影响训练速度与稳定性。
nodes.summaryEn: Determines how gradients update parameters and how far each training step moves, directly affecting speed and stability.

sources.title: Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization
Accurate, Large Minibatch SGD: Training ImageNet in 1 Hour
Deep Learning — Optimization for Training Deep Models

nodes.title: 参数高效微调 PEFT / LoRA
nodes.summary: 冻结大部分基础权重，只训练少量适配参数，以更低显存和存储成本定制模型。
nodes.summaryEn: Freezes most base-model weights and trains a small set of adaptation parameters, reducing the memory and storage needed to customize a model.

nodes.title: 分布式训练与并行策略
nodes.summary: 把模型、数据和计算拆到多张加速卡上，突破单卡显存与训练时间限制。
nodes.summaryEn: Distributes models, data, and computation across multiple accelerators to overcome single-device memory limits and reduce training time.

nodes.title: 对比学习
nodes.summary: 把相关样本表示拉近、不相关样本推远，学出可检索、可迁移的表示空间。
nodes.summaryEn: Pulls representations of related examples together and pushes unrelated examples apart to learn a transferable space for retrieval and downstream tasks.

sources.title: A Simple Framework for Contrastive Learning of Visual Representations
Representation Learning with Contrastive Predictive Coding
Momentum Contrast for Unsupervised Visual Representation Learning

nodes.title: 模型合并与适配器组合
nodes.summary: 在不重新完整训练的情况下组合多个模型或适配器的能力，但容易产生参数干扰。
nodes.summaryEn: Combines capabilities from multiple models or adapters without another full training run, but parameter interference can erase the expected gains.

nodes.title: 模型评测与基准
nodes.summary: 用可复现任务衡量模型能力、鲁棒性与安全性，并识别污染和指标错配。
nodes.summaryEn: Uses reproducible tasks to measure model capability, robustness, and safety while identifying contamination and metric mismatch.

sources.title: HELM: Holistic Evaluation of Language Models
Evaluating Large Language Models Trained on Code
Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena

nodes.title: 模型路由与级联系统
nodes.summary: 按请求难度、成本与风险选择不同模型，让系统不必所有任务都调用最贵模型。
nodes.summaryEn: Selects among models for each request based on difficulty, cost, and risk instead of sending every task to the most expensive model.

sources.title: Learning to Route LLMs with Confidence Tokens
Selective Classification for Deep Neural Networks

nodes.title: 数据漂移与持续监控
nodes.titleEn: Data Drift, Concept Drift, and Continuous Monitoring
nodes.summary: 上线后的输入、用户与目标会变化，持续监控负责发现模型质量随环境悄悄退化。
nodes.summaryEn: Detects when changing inputs, users, or goals silently degrade a deployed system's quality, cost, or safety.

sources.title: Learning under Concept Drift: A Review
Failing Loudly: An Empirical Study of Methods for Detecting Dataset Shift
Hidden Technical Debt in Machine Learning Systems

nodes.title: Agent 身份、权限与密钥管理
nodes.summary: 明确 Agent 代表谁、能访问什么、凭什么执行，并隔离密钥与高风险权限。
nodes.summaryEn: Defines whom an agent represents, what it may access, and why an action is authorized while isolating secrets and high-risk privileges.

sources.title: RFC 9700: OAuth 2.0 Security Best Current Practice

nodes.title: Flow Matching / Rectified Flow
nodes.summary: 直接学习把噪声连续运输到数据的速度场，是与扩散紧密相关的现代生成路径。
nodes.summaryEn: Learns a continuous velocity field that transports noise into data, providing a modern generative route closely related to diffusion.

nodes.title: 训练数据治理
nodes.summary: 管理训练数据的来源、许可、质量、去重、配比与可追溯性，决定能力也决定风险。
nodes.summaryEn: Manages data provenance, licensing, quality, deduplication, mixture, and traceability—shaping both capability and risk.

sources.title: Deduplicating Training Data Makes Language Models Better

nodes.title: 不确定性校准与选择性预测
nodes.summary: 让置信度与真实正确率匹配，并在风险过高时拒答、检索或转人工。
nodes.summaryEn: Aligns confidence with observed correctness and lets a system abstain, retrieve evidence, verify, or escalate when risk is too high.

sources.title: On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks
Selective Classification for Deep Neural Networks

nodes.title: 推理时计算与验证器
nodes.summary: 在回答阶段投入更多候选、搜索、验证和工具计算，以成本与延迟换取成功率。
nodes.summaryEn: Spends more inference-time computation on candidates, search, verification, and tools, exchanging cost and latency for success rate.

sources.title: Self-Consistency Improves Chain of Thought Reasoning

nodes.title: 状态空间模型与 Mamba
nodes.summary: 用压缩状态线性处理长序列，并通过选择机制决定哪些信息保留或遗忘。
nodes.summaryEn: Processes long sequences linearly through a compressed state and uses selection mechanisms to decide what information to retain or forget.

sources.title: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
Efficiently Modeling Long Sequences with Structured State Spaces
Simplified State Space Layers for Sequence Modeling

nodes.title: 声音克隆
nodes.summary: 从目标说话者的参考语音提取身份表示或声学提示，生成该说话者从未说过的新语音；可在推理时零样本条件化，也可用较长语音微调模型提高一致性。
nodes.summaryEn: Uses reference speech to condition synthesis on a target speaker, either at inference time or through speaker-specific adaptation.

sources.title: SV2TTS：Transfer Learning from Speaker Verification to Multispeaker TTS
VALL-E：Neural Codec Language Models are Zero-Shot TTS Synthesizers

pages.title: AI 软件使用教程：提示词、Agent、编程与创作
AI 对话与提示词常见问题
pages.titleEn: AI conversation and prompting: frequently asked questions

pages.title: 如果需求含有错误前提，怎样允许 AI 先指出问题而不是顺着回答？
pages.titleEn: If my request has a false premise, how can I let AI challenge it first?

pages.title: 先让 AI 扮演专家再提问题，有没有用？
pages.titleEn: Does asking AI to act as an expert help?

pages.title: 主语用你、我，还是你们、我们？要不要加敬语？对 AI 的态度如何？
pages.titleEn: Should I say “you,” “I,” “you all” or “we”? How polite should I be to AI?

pages.title: “扮演专家”是在规定视角、语气，还是能提高事实准确性？应分别怎样检查？
pages.titleEn: Does an expert role set a viewpoint or tone, or improve factual accuracy? How do I check each?

pages.title: 与其指定职业角色，直接列出分析标准有什么不同？
pages.titleEn: How is listing analysis criteria different from assigning a professional role?

pages.title: 让一个 AI 扮演多位专家讨论，能否当作独立意见？
pages.titleEn: Can a discussion between several experts played by one AI count as independent opinions?

pages.title: 夸奖、责备、催促或威胁措辞会如何影响 AI？
pages.titleEn: How do praise, blame, urgency or threats affect AI?

pages.title: “你”“我们”“我”等提示词的主语该怎么选？是必要的吗？影响答案吗？
pages.titleEn: How should I choose “you,” “we” or “I” in prompts? Are pronouns necessary, and do they affect answers?

pages.title: 用词是否必须专业规范，还是可以使用民间用词？
pages.titleEn: Must I use standard technical terminology, or can I use everyday expressions?

pages.title: 不知道专业名称时，能否通过用途、特征、例子和反例让 AI 帮忙确定概念？
pages.titleEn: If I do not know a technical name, can AI identify it from uses, features, examples and counterexamples?

pages.title: 和 AI 对话时使用的专有名词是一直用一个还是可以换着用？是否要以 AI 生成的专有名词为基准？
pages.titleEn: Should I keep one name for a concept or use synonyms? Must I adopt AI's terminology?

pages.title: 项目内自定义名称、缩写和行话，应怎样定义并保持一致？
pages.titleEn: How should I define and consistently use project-specific names, abbreviations and jargon?

pages.title: 中文、英文、方言、网络用语或混合语言，何时需要补充解释？
pages.titleEn: When should I explain Chinese, English, dialect, slang or mixed-language expressions?

pages.title: 问题描述多清楚算清楚？主谓宾都要有吗？环境描写、背景信息有帮助吗？
pages.titleEn: How clear is clear enough? Do I need complete sentences, setting and background?

pages.title: 标点符号是否必须完美？为什么？
pages.titleEn: Must punctuation be perfect? Why does it matter?

pages.title: 不完整句子、错别字、语音转写错误，哪些会改变任务含义？
pages.titleEn: Which fragments, typos or speech-transcription errors change the task's meaning?

pages.title: 标点、换行、标题、列表和引号分别在什么时候帮助区分含义？
pages.titleEn: When do punctuation, line breaks, headings, lists and quotation marks clarify meaning?

pages.title: 把要求放在开头、结尾或重复多次，是否必要，怎样避免写成互相冲突的要求？
pages.titleEn: Should requirements go first, last or be repeated? How can I avoid contradictions?

pages.title: 提供一个案例能让 AI 生成的内容提高多少？
pages.titleEn: How much does providing one example improve AI's output?

pages.title: 怎样避免 AI 把示例中的姓名、数字和情节复制到新任务？
pages.titleEn: How do I stop AI copying example names, numbers and events into a new task?

pages.title: 怎样区分“更像示例”和“内容更正确”，评价案例带来的改善？
pages.titleEn: How do I distinguish resembling an example from being more correct when evaluating its benefit?

pages.title: 如果描述不出需求，该怎么办？遵循哪些步骤？
pages.titleEn: What if I cannot describe what I need? Which steps should I follow?

pages.title: 如何发现AI在长任务中擅自改变目标或完成标准，并尽量不打断工作？
pages.titleEn: How can I detect AI changing a long task's goals or completion criteria without repeatedly interrupting it?
